visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, voluminous curly brown hair and gold hoop earrings is shown in a medium close-up shot. She is speaking directly to the camera with a friendly and expressive facial expression, her mouth moving clearly as she narrates. The background is a minimalist, beige-colored indoor wall with soft, natural lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a wide shot of the Tokyo Toy Museum lobby area. The walls are adorned with wooden panels and cubbies containing colorful books and brochures labeled with the museum's name. Several small, child-sized wooden chairs in bright red and green are positioned in the foreground. (3) A floor plan map of the museum is displayed on a wall, featuring hand-drawn style illustrations. The camera then shifts to a medium shot of the woman and a young girl with pigtails as they examine yellow paper materials during a scheduled handcraft session in a bright room. (4) A man in a red tracksuit and a young boy sit at a long wooden table, intensely focused on a craft project involving white paper cups. They are using their hands to assemble a makeshift watch, which is later shown in a close-up on the child's wrist. (5) A montage follows showing various wooden games: a child plays a wooden table game with knobs, a spinning top knocks over miniature wooden bowling pins, and a boy carefully guides a wooden ball through a vertical maze using attached strings. (6) A young girl in a black and white striped shirt operates a balance game board, tilting it to move a ball along blue wavy paths. The environment is warm, with wooden floors and shelves filled with toys, lit by bright indoor studio-style lights. (7) The children move to a simulated farm area with wooden soil beds. They use their hands to 'harvest' wooden carrots and bright red chili peppers. A girl named Ida is shown placing wooden mushrooms into a small woven basket in a kitchen-themed play area. (8) In a brightly lit hallway, the woman attempts to catch five balls on a large wooden kendama but fails. A man in a red jacket then takes the toy and successfully catches all five balls in one smooth motion, leading to a celebration. (9) The group enters a large circular wooden tub filled with thousands of small, smooth wooden balls. Kids and adults are seen submerged in the balls, laughing. A man in a black North Face jacket stands at the edge, watching the children play. (10) In the museum's gift shop, the woman operates a white and blue capsule toy machine. She turns the dial to release a clear plastic capsule containing a miniature wooden toy. A close-up shows the tiny wooden kendama and a wooden yo-yo. (11) The video concludes with the woman crouched down next to the boy, Giorgie, who is holding his new toys. They are smiling and talking in the hallway of the museum, surrounded by wooden shelves and other visitors in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female adult speaker introducing the video with a warm and friendly vocal tone. Her pitch is moderately high, and her speech rate is conversational. There is no background music at this stage, only a clean room tone. (2) An upbeat acoustic folk-style background music track fades in, featuring prominent acoustic guitar strumming at approximately 115 BPM. The woman's voice becomes more animated and excited as the ambient sound floor shifts to include the gentle hubbub of a public museum. (3) A distinct mechanical "click" and "rustle" of paper materials are heard as a man's voice enters the mix, speaking with a calm tone. The BGM maintains a steady, energetic tempo, providing a cheerful foundation for the workshop sounds. (4) Several percussive "clack" and "thud" sounds of wooden objects hitting one another are captured as children play the various games. These transient sounds trigger new audio focus, emphasizing the tactile nature of the wooden toys displayed on screen. (5) The woman emits a high-pitched exclamation of playful frustration, followed by a rhythmic shift in the background music. The laughter of children and the muffled chatter of other museum visitors create a lively, high-arousal acoustic atmosphere. (6) A series of rapid "pop" and "ding" sound effects are mixed in to highlight successful moments in the games. These are followed by a loud burst of collective cheering and applause from the crowd, signaling a shared moment of victory. (7) A textural shift occurs as the sound of thousands of wooden balls rustling and clinking fills the audio spectrum. This broadband noise is characteristic of the ball pit area. The BGM remains present but slightly lower in the mix. (8) The sound of a mechanical gear turning and plastic shells clinking accompanies the use of the capsule machine. The woman's voice returns to a conversational level as she interacts with the child. (9) The video concludes with a dialogue between the woman and a child, ending with a final musical cadence and a gentle fade-out of both the speech and the acoustic guitar track.
